insights.one_liner: Albert Heijn is the biggest Dutch supermarket chain, part of Ahold Delhaize, with head-office roles in Zaandam and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: It is the biggest supermarket chain in the Netherlands, founded in 1887, with head office in Zaandam.
Its 2 open jobs here are a senior data role and a marketing internship, both in Zaandam.
Its website and customer side are almost entirely in Dutch.

open.text: Albert Heijn B.V. and Albert Heijn Support B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Both current postings are open to people who don't speak Dutch.
It is owned by Dutch group Koninklijke Ahold Delhaize N.V.

growth.text: It is expanding in Belgium, for example taking over a Delhaize store in Lommel.
Reports say it has overtaken Lidl in Flanders, which Lidl disputes.

worth_knowing.text: There is reported discontent inside Albert Heijn over its push to centralise decisions.
Its sustainability lead is leaving for parent Ahold Delhaize.
In a YouGov fresh-food ranking, Plus pushed Albert Heijn out of the top 3.
